groups.defect: Mode-3 unit and playlist integration tests never wait for and assert the legacy writes, allowing missing legacy writes to go undetected.
groups.rationale: All report missing verification of the legacy half of dual writes. The unit and integration tests require separate edits, so the merged comment must preserve both locations.

groups.defect: Legacy Update receives raw objInfo instead of the unified store's committed object through updateWrapper, allowing recomputation to diverge or fail.
groups.rationale: All identify the removed wrapper at the same Legacy.Update call. References to request cancellation and asynchronous ordering describe compounding conditions rather than separate findings within these comments.

groups.defect: Create and Update storage failures use the legacy recorder, legacy DeleteCollection uses the storage recorder, and successful Delete uses the object name as the kind label.
groups.rationale: The two comprehensive suggestions explicitly cover all four faulty metric calls, linking the narrower suggestions. Each affected call requires correction.

groups.defect: Delete returns on unified-storage NotFound before attempting legacy cleanup, leaving legacy-only objects undeleted.
groups.rationale: Both report the same removed NotFound exception in Delete's early-return branch.

groups.defect: All four asynchronous legacy write paths inherit request cancellation, allowing handler completion to abort the background writes.
groups.rationale: Each identifies the same request-context lifetime mistake repeated across Create, Delete, Update, and DeleteCollection. The test references explain why cancellation is missed; they do not independently report the missing legacy assertions covered by the test group.
